scope: Attribute the current Extruder2 entity failures and determine whether they establish a libdxfrw parser defect.

source.provenance: Local corpus sample; producer provenance is not established.

libdxfrw.instrumentation: Temporary debug-only logging exposed each failed entity handle, encoded type, and missing BLOCK_RECORD owner; the instrumentation was removed after attribution.

format_reference.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sections: §20.4.2: common entity handle data includes an optional owner soft-pointer reference.
§20.4.52: R2004+ BLOCK HEADER records an owned-object count and corresponding entity hard-owner references, plus its BLOCK and ENDBLK hard-owner references.

decision: The failed entity frames consistently name 40 owner handles for which neither libdxfrw's BLOCK_RECORD map nor LibreDWG's BLOCK_HEADER/BLOCK_CONTROL graph has a matching record. LibreDWG independently reports the same owner values for all 474 entities. This evidence supports an incomplete/orphan source graph, not a shared entity-body parser defect. Keep this physical source refused; do not weaken owner checks or change LINE/POINT/SOLID/MTEXT/BLOCK/ENDBLK parsers. Reconsider only if producer-qualified evidence proves the referenced block records exist in a source structure both readers missed.
